shell.verifyEmailBanner: Your email address is not verified yet. Open the verification link we sent you.

validation.emailInvalid: That is not a valid email address.
validation.emailTooLong: That email address is too long.
validation.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {{count}} characters.
validation.passwordTooLong: Password must be at most {{count}} characters.
validation.passwordsDoNotMatch: The two passwords do not match.
validation.displayNameTooLong: That display name is too long.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Carry on building and preserving your family record.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: It takes a minute, and you can start straight away.
register.passwordHint: At least {{count}} characters. Pick something you will remember and nobody else would guess.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email. If it has an account, we will send a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Changing it ends every session currently signed in to this account.
reset.signsOutEverywhere: This signs your account out on every device.
reset.missingTokenBody: The reset link has no token in it. Request a new one.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.successBody: Thank you. Your account is ready.
verify.failedBody: That link is not valid, or it has expired.
verify.missingToken: The verification link has no token in it.

account.title: My account
account.subtitle: How you appear to others, the language of the interface, and where you are signed in.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.subtitle: The browsers and devices currently signed in to this account.

logoutAll.title: Security
logoutAll.heading: Sign out everywhere
logoutAll.body: Ends every session, including this one. Use it if you think someone else has access to your account.
logoutAll.confirmBody: You will have to sign in again everywhere, including here.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.emailAlreadyRegistered: That email address already has an account.
errors.validationFailed: Some of what you entered is not valid.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.permissionDenied: You may not perform this action.
errors.server: The server is having trouble. Try again shortly.
errors.clanNotFound: This clan does not exist, or you are not a member of it.
errors.branchNotFound: That branch does not exist in this clan.
errors.invalidClanCode: That does not look like a join code.
errors.duplicatePendingRequest: You have already asked to join. Wait for an answer, or withdraw that request first.
errors.membershipExists: You are already a member of this clan.
errors.versionConflict: Somebody else changed this while you were editing. Reload and try again.
errors.cycleDetected: A branch cannot be moved underneath itself.
errors.lastAdminProtected: This clan would be left with nobody able to administer it.

health.title: System health
health.subtitle: This page calls the server directly, through the same network layer the whole application uses.
health.hint: Check that the API is running with the dev profile and that PostgreSQL is up.

error.unexpectedBody: This section could not be displayed. Reload the page.

onboarding.title: Start your family record
onboarding.subtitle: Either create a clan and invite your relatives, or join one that somebody in your family has already started.

create.title: Create a clan
create.body: Set up the record for your family. You will get a code to share with relatives so they can join.

join.title: Join with a code
join.body: Somebody in your family has already started the record. Enter the code they gave you.

field.name: Clan name
field.surnameHint: Used to build the join code. Diacritics are removed, so Nguyễn becomes NGUYEN.
field.codeTooltip: Generated once and never changed, so a code you share stays valid.

validation.nameRequired: Enter a name for the clan.

create.title: Create a clan
create.subtitle: Only the name is required. Everything else can be filled in later.
create.codeBody: Share this with your relatives. Anyone who enters it can ask to join, and you decide who comes in.
create.copyUnavailable: Could not copy automatically — select the code and copy it.

join.title: Join a clan
join.subtitle: Enter the code a relative shared with you. We will show you which family it belongs to before you ask to join.

field.message: A note for whoever approves this

placeholder.message: Who you are, and how you are related.

join.alreadyMember: You are already in this clan.
join.alreadyRequested: You have already asked to join. Wait for an answer.
join.sent: Request sent. You will see the answer on your profile.

settings.title: Clan settings
settings.subtitle: The name, where the family comes from, and the record you keep about it.
settings.readOnly: Only the person who created this clan can change it for now.

delete.title: Delete this clan
delete.heading: Delete the clan
delete.body: The clan disappears for everyone in it. There is a 30-day window in which it can be brought back.
delete.confirmBody: Everyone loses access to it. It can be restored within 30 days.

notFound.title: Clan not found
notFound.body: This clan does not exist, or you are not a member of it.

branch.title: Branches
branch.subtitle: The chi and nhánh your family divides into. Drag a branch onto another to move it, and everything beneath it moves too.
branch.readOnly: Only the person who created this clan can change its branches for now.
branch.addChild: Add a branch under this one

validation.nameRequired: Enter a name for the branch.

archive.confirmBody: It stays in the record and keeps its members, but nothing new can be added to it. Branches beneath it must be archived first.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Who is in this clan, and who has asked to be.

inbox.approveBody: Which branch do they belong to? Leave it empty to admit them to the clan without placing them yet.
inbox.rejectBody: The reason is shown to the person who asked. They are a relative — say something useful.

remove.confirmBody: They lose access to this clan. They can ask to join again.

leave.confirmBody: You lose access to it and would have to ask to join again.

myRequests.title: My join requests
myRequests.subtitle: Requests you have sent, and what came of them.
myRequests.empty: You have not asked to join any clan.
